title: On Diving from the highest board
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：dive　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dive 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the guide ① dived from the highest board with great care, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② dives from the highest board on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ dive from the highest board at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ dived from the highest board before — a line in the guidebook for July 1958 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Diving from the highest board with great care, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ dive for the ring in three fathoms on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Dive for the ring in three fathoms at once and never mention it again.

By 1971 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ dives for the ring in three fathoms with great care every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ dived from the highest board again when nobody else would.

⑩ To dive from the highest board, my mother said in 1976, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody dives from the highest board on the same day again and somebody must dive from the highest board with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 跳水（一般过去式 dived from the highest board：1964 年向导头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 跳水（一般现在 dives from the highest board：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 跳水（不定式 to dive from the highest board：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 跳水（过去完成时 had dived from the highest board：1958 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 跳水（动名词 diving from the highest board 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 下潜（dive for the ring in three fathoms：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去下潜下到三英寻深去捡那只戒指）
G. v. 下潜（dive for the ring in three fathoms：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 跳水（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 dives for the ring in three fathoms，而母亲又一次 dived from the highest board）

answers.why: dive 意为“跳水”，1964 年向导小心翼翼地跳水从最高的跳台上跳下，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 dived。
dive 意为“跳水”，自那以后向导当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 dives。
dive 意为“跳水”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯跳水从最高的跳台上跳下”，此处为不定式 to dive from the highest board。
dive 意为“跳水”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1971 年之前就有人跳水过，故用过去完成时 had dived。
dive 意为“跳水”，向导说“跳水从最高的跳台上跳下这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 diving from the highest board 作主语。
dive 意为“下潜”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去下潜下到三英寻深去捡那只戒指”，should ever 之后用原形 dive for the ring in three fathoms。
dive 意为“下潜”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻下潜下到三英寻深去捡那只戒指（dive for the ring in three fathoms at once），以后再也不要提起。
dive 意为“跳水”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例下潜下到三英寻深去捡那只戒指，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 dives。
dive 意为“跳水”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地跳水从最高的跳台上跳下，用一般过去式 dived 叙述。
dive 意为“跳水”，结尾那句是母亲 1976 年的话：要跳水从最高的跳台上跳下，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 dive 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the guide dived from the highest board with great care, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide dives from the highest board on the same day whenever the valley asks.
Diving from the highest board with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever dive for the ring in three fathoms on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley dives for the ring in three fathoms with great care every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother dived from the highest board again, and the valley remembered that half.
